Left: heatmap of edge confidence across 25 edge clusters (E1-E25, rows) and eight cell clusters (C1-C8, columns), colored white-red (low-high, range 0-1). Right: heatmap of edge counts per cluster, colored white-violet (0-1,000). (b) Bubble plot of the top five regulators per edge cluster (≥10 targets). Bubble size and color denote regulator degree, scaled continuously (blue-green-yellow).
